data.name: Shubham Patil
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Shubham Patil has made a big mark in cricket. With 15 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 31*, with an average of 10.73 and a quick strike rate of 128.26. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 13 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 21.4 overs, taking 9 wickets at an economy rate of 10.48. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
